attempt_id.description: Request classification, route or locked run-unit identity; text.

branch.description: Request classification, route or locked run-unit identity; text.

client_disconnected.description: Observed incoming transport state; boolean, with no credential value.

cursor.description: Script session and turn position, or null outside the cursor.

hash.description: Raw ledger identity or raw-body sha256; not the stable masked digest.

incoming_auth_dropped.description: Observed incoming transport state; boolean, with no credential value.

life.description: Request classification, route or locked run-unit identity; text.

load.description: Exactly three load averages (1, 5, 15 minutes), times 1000, rounded half-even.

lock_hash.description: sha256 hex of the run lock or masked canonical body.

method.description: Request classification, route or locked run-unit identity; text.

model_in.description: Request classification, route or locked run-unit identity; text.

path.description: Request classification, route or locked run-unit identity; text.

prev_hash.description: Raw ledger identity or raw-body sha256; not the stable masked digest.

req.description: Raw ledger identity or raw-body sha256; not the stable masked digest.

req_masked_sha256.description: sha256 hex of the run lock or masked canonical body.

resp.description: Raw ledger identity or raw-body sha256; not the stable masked digest.

resp_masked_sha256.description: sha256 hex of the run lock or masked canonical body.

role.description: S1 request role, including RING0 scripted roles.

run.description: Raw ledger identity or raw-body sha256; not the stable masked digest.

served.description: Director served kind, such as script or forward.

sim_now.description: Logical simulated time, in integer ticks (R05), not wall-clock time.

subrole.description: Request classification, route or locked run-unit identity; text.

system.description: Request classification, route or locked run-unit identity; text.

t.description: Wall-clock Unix time, in integer milliseconds.

t_ms.description: Elapsed request time, in integer milliseconds.

type.description: Request record kind only; lifecycle and send errors are separate contracts.

upstream.description: Upstream attempt diagnostics; canonical open objects, no floats.

write_turn_readback.description: Whether the write-turn body matched its expected readback.
